opening.argument: The speaker calls the possible XLM investment announcement speculation and expressly says there is no guarantee it will happen. Price movement is treated the same way: a run-up is only a possibility, while the technical target depends on a confirmed breakout. That is market analysis framed by uncertainty, not a promise of an outcome. The separate promotion for leveraged XRP futures and the request for paid membership do not establish a connection to a deceptive investment benefit. Asking viewers to like or share is ordinary audience engagement. Those elements do not change the speculative character of the XLM discussion.
